title: Disjoint Set Island Counter
statement: Given an R x C 2D grid containing '1's (land) and '0's (water), count the number of connected islands. An island is surrounded by water and is formed by connecting adjacent lands horizontally or vertically.
input_format: First line: R C. Next R lines: string of C characters representing grid rows.
output_format: Output a single integer, the number of islands.
